title: Storybook Workbench project settings
description: The project's own rules for the Workbench skills. Owned by the project, never overwritten by a skill update. Command-line flags win over these.

css.description: Glob of the CSS files that declare the tokens, e.g. src/**/*.css

darkSelectors.description: Text that marks a dark-theme block when it appears in its selector or @media prelude, e.g. .dark, [data-theme=dark], prefers-color-scheme: dark

nameMap.description: Figma variable name → CSS custom property, e.g. "fg/error": "--color-error-text". Beats the name guessing and settles collisions.

ignore.description: Figma variable names to leave out of parity; * matches anything, e.g. Size/*

variantValues.description: Figma variant value → code prop value for Code Connect, e.g. "status - success": "success"

codeConnectLabel.description: Default label for Code Connect mappings
